text: little space: Heb. moment | a nail: Or, a pinne [symbol in wrong place] | in his holy place: That is, a constant and sure abode
to repair: Heb. to set up
by thy servants: Heb. by the hand of thy servants | from one end to another: Heb. from mouth to mouth
hast punished us less, then our iniquities deserve: Heb. hast withheld beneath our iniquities
